topics.label: Introduction to Cancer Hallmarks and Progression
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the lecture structure, learning outcomes, and the multi-step hallmarks framework of cancer progression.

topics.label: Sustained Proliferative Signaling and Growth Factor Independence
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the signaling cascades and oncogenic mutations that drive autonomous cell proliferation and survival.

topics.label: Differentiation Block in Tumorigenesis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how mutations prevent cells from completing terminal differentiation across hematological and epithelial cancers.

topics.label: Evasion of Apoptosis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details how tumor cells avoid programmed cell death through alterations in pro- and anti-apoptotic regulators.

topics.label: Replicative Immortality and Cellular Senescence
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how cancer cells overcome telomere shortening to achieve unlimited replicative potential while bypassing normal senescent stress responses.

topics.label: Cancer Cell Metabolism and Metabolic Rewiring
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe aerobic glycolysis, metabolic rewiring, and the role of oncometabolites in altering cancer cell physiology and epigenetics.

topics.label: Induction of Tumor Angiogenesis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic discusses how growing tumors trigger new blood vessel formation to supply oxygen and nutrients.

topics.label: Tumor Invasion and Metastasis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics analyze the sequential processes, dissemination routes, microenvironmental influences, and clonal genetics underlying metastatic spread.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion and Summary
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer summarizes the collective impact of cancer hallmarks, references recent literature, and concludes the session.
